# libcurl ABI

Exported functions, constants, struct layouts and link-level identity of libcurl, as an application compiled against `include/curl/` sees them. Values and layouts come from a probe compiled with gcc for `aarch64-redhat-linux`.

- library: `libcurl.so.4.8.0` (soname `libcurl.so.4`, libtool `12:0:8`)
- exported functions: 100 (10 variadic, 5 deprecated); `lib/libcurl.def` lists 100
- constants: 1213 (792 enum members, 421 object-like macros, 5 of them not values); 67 carry a deprecation attribute
- function-like or empty macros: 28
- structs with public layout: 18; opaque types: 4
- symbols-in-versions rows: 1185 (30 removed, numbers reserved)
- discrepancies: 82

Versioned symbols are off by default; when on, the version node name depends on the TLS backend:

| condition | prefix |
|---|---|
| CURL_WITH_MULTI_SSL | MULTISSL_ |
| CURL_USE_OPENSSL | OPENSSL_ |
| CURL_USE_MBEDTLS | MBEDTLS_ |
| CURL_USE_WOLFSSL | WOLFSSL_ |
| CURL_USE_GNUTLS | GNUTLS_ |
| CURL_USE_RUSTLS | RUSTLS_ |

## Error strings

Returned by the `*_strerror` functions in a build with verbose strings (the `verbose-strings` test feature); without it they return only the `#else` strings. Checked line by line against test 1538.

| function | codes with a message | unknown code | without verbose strings |
|---|---|---|---|
| curl_easy_strerror | 87 | Unknown error | No error, Error |
| curl_multi_strerror | 14 | Unknown error | No error, Error |
| curl_share_strerror | 6 | CURLSHcode unknown | No error, Error |
| curl_url_strerror | 33 | CURLUcode unknown | No error, Error |
